relations: Rippling surface pattern reshapes light shafts, causing the bright sun patch and beams to drift toward the right.
Viewpoint shifting through water moves the small bubble pair on the right downward and outward.
Bubbles gathered near the left edge thin out and drift leftward as the camera advances.
Suspended particles drift slowly within the light column while the green flare flickers near bottom center.
caption: The video captures an underwater viewpoint looking upward toward a rippling water surface, where bright sunlight breaks through and casts a fan of shimmering light shafts into deep blue water. The sun patch and beams gradually shift across the top of the frame, moving toward the right as the surface pattern continually reshapes the rays. Bubbles gathered near the left edge thin out and drift toward the left, while a small pair on the right slides downward and outward as the viewpoint shifts slowly through the water. Fine suspended particles drift slowly within the column, and a faint green flare flickers near the bottom center. Light, bubbles, and particles keep changing position throughout the visible underwater view.
